bars.label: pyROAR
bars.total_reason: pyROAR token_info not read and no registry figure
bars.note: The frozen burn ledger: one pyROAR per ROAR burned in the festival, live from the cw20 (or the registry's measured figure, dated, when the read fails). The black remainder sits in the burners' own wallets — the burn ledger (in build) names them. Lion DAO's published figures: {pyroar.reported_participants|int} wallets, {pyroar.reported_community|big} community + {pyroar.reported_dao|big} DAO burned, top wallet {pyroar.reported_top_wallet|big} — theirs, beside ours.

bars.label: ROAR20
bars.total_reason: Solana RPC not read and no registry figure
bars.note: Supply is fixed at mint (authority revoked) — the registry carries it when the RPC does not answer. Solana token accounts by size (getTokenLargestAccounts), not wallets: the largest is {roar20.top1_short} — usually a pool's vault, unverified here. The black remainder is every smaller account. Holder count needs an indexer (the ROAR20 cron duty). Price, cap and liquidity are DexScreener's, on the Burning Lions row.
